statement: C1 is an integration case for discovery, DM delivery, idle-peer wake and simulated resource serialization. Its live provider attempts were rejected and do not establish agent behavior. C2 is a separate real Pi split-coding utility pilot: paired native-model artifacts were graded at the request-budget cutoff, but neither combined application passed within the same 24-request budget. See coding-pilot.json for outcomes, unknown usage, source hashes and limitations. Controls prove grader behavior only. The feature entries below describe C1 coverage, not full PR certification; NOT RUN means no valid live feature evidence, not that no provider attempt occurred.

features.eval_lane: c1 designed (graded: daemon DM rows resolved by agent+session; two-way ordering corroborated by the sender's own successful agent_message_send tool result with the exact backend id, so delayed instrument polls cannot demote a real earlier send). Live NOT RUN; grader exercised by controls only

C1 requires a real idle-peer wake correlated with Pi's own first user input and backend DM ID. Pi 1.0.0 is installed and used in C2, but C2 does not require or separately certify an idle wake. Active-session DMs and code outcomes in C2 are not evidence for every-DM wake reliability.
NOT COVERED: c1 does not grade ack/release/retry
NOT COVERED by 2-agent cases; would need a transport stress lane (not built). Not claimed.

Offline clock-skew controls only filter ordering. Live NOT RUN
NOT COVERED. Request-budget exhaustion by a healthy agent is a scored failure; provider 429 is unscorable. Neither exercised live.
